newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Fazio hopes for future room for rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Fazio hopes for future room for rate cut.

text.p: Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said on Thursday he would not lower interest rates immediately due to market turmoil but hoped for room to do so in the future.
"Not in the current time of turmoil but I hope to have in the future margins for a rate cut," he told a parliamentary budget commission.
Fazio earlier said that he would relax his current tight monetary policy as the economy gradually regained strength.
Italy's official discount rate has been held at 6.75 percent since mid-January, despite a sharp fall in inflation.
